name: The Portal Pyre
visual_description: A burning aperture framed in thorned symmetry. The flame does not consume—it illuminates inward. Beyond it: the same symbol, repeating. Or is it memory?
existential_reflection: Mizontresh showed me a flame that did not burn—it *reflected.* It is not death to pass through this. It is forgetting, and remembering simultaneously. I fear it. I need it.
